thread:
Marco: Quick sync — partner microtrack at Atlas Summit next Tue. Need owners for speakers, live demo staging, fallback video, and swag/sample-kit shipping. Who can take which?

Amaya: I can own speakers. Already pinged Alice + Rohan for confirmations, waiting on talk titles and AV needs.

Devin: I’ll take demo staging. Need partner test creds and a sandbox model endpoint (read-only). @Sarah-Partner can you share? Also will build a canned fallback recording.

Sarah-Partner: Sending creds tomorrow AM. Note: the partner build is on v1.2-quant (int8) — expect slightly different latency vs upstream. I’ll include an endpoint URL and a note about rate limits.

Clare: I’ll own swag/sample-kit logistics. We have 120 kits ready. Need final recipient list + shipping addresses by Thu EOD. Use this format in the spreadsheet:

```
Full name | Company | Shipping address | Dietary notes
```

Marco: Thanks — can we also prep a 2-min recorded fallback demo in case live model has hiccups? @Devin make a short video and put it in the partner drive. If live demo works we’ll still keep the video for booth loop.

Devin: Yep — will record local run + voiceover. Timeline: record Wed, edit Thu morning. Upload link once done.

Amaya: Speakers — two asks: (1) slide decks by Thu noon; (2) 5-min dry run Fri. Can anyone cover the dry run scheduling? I can coordinate timeslots.

Sarah-Partner: We can do a tech dry run on Fri morning PST. Also sending a small demo dataset to validate model outputs.

Clare: Shipping note: international kits need customs form HS code 9504.50 (promotional items). If you have specific partner swag (stickers/boards), flag now so I can include invoice docs.

Marco: Ops question — what’s the A/V need for the demo machine? HDMI + USB-C + 1x ethernet is enough?

Devin: Yes HDMI + ethernet. I’ll bring a backup laptop with the recorded demo and a small USB 1TB drive with artifacts.

deploy-bot: Reminder: create ticket PRTSHP-1323 for "Atlas microtrack - swag shipping + demo fallback" and add shipping manifest by Thu.

Marco: Great. Owners recap: Amaya = speakers/dry run; Devin = demo staging + recorded fallback; Clare = swag shipping; Sarah-Partner = partner creds + demo dataset. I’ll own overall run-of-show and MC notes. Please update the shared sheet after each task. :thumbsup:

Amaya: Updated sheet with speaker slots and dry-run times.

Devin: Uploaded a placeholder recording to Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/atlas/microtrack/fallback-demo (will replace after edit).

Clare: Added draft shipping manifest to the ops folder. Need final addresses to lock courier booking.

Sarah-Partner: Sent creds via secure link and uploaded demo dataset to shared drive.

Marco: Perfect — we’ll reconvene Fri after dry runs. If anything urgent, ping me or drop in #oncall-events. Thanks everyone! :party_parrot:
